assignments.name: verdict
assignments.value: Not yet for most owners: keep the classifier you have. Yes if a Mac already runs in your office and you have a developer: free, private, millisecond email sorting.

assignments.name: cost
assignments.value: Code free (Apache-2.0), models free on Hugging Face (check each model card license), no per-message fee. Needs an Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 14+, Python 3.11+.
